_about: ahoxy.com URLs that had Google impressions/clicks (GSC sc-domain:ahoxy.com, 2025-07..2026-11) or GA4 landing sessions (2025-01..2026-07, SG/CN excluded) but no exact 301 rule, so they fell to the 404 stub (HTTP 404 + JS move). generate-redirects.mjs turns each into an edge 301, highest evidence first, within the 2,000 static limit.
